sources.title: TIGERweb State and County boundary: Echols County, Georgia (GEOID 13101)
sources.transformations: Copied unchanged to data/raw. Derived only the documented county bounding box and public-geography context in data/processed/echols_valdosta_public_geography_v1/public_geography_summary.json.
sources.limitations: A county boundary does not identify roads, EMS coverage, ambulance locations, dispatch practices, patient incidents, or operational access.

sources.title: Hospital General Information public directory, retrieved page containing Georgia facilities
sources.transformations: Selected facility IDs 110122 and 111326. Preserved their public identity and address values in public_hospital_references.csv. CMS does not provide coordinates in this endpoint.
sources.limitations: This directory is a source snapshot, not a live service-status feed, trauma-center directory, destination protocol, or statement that a facility is appropriate for any patient.

sources.title: TIGERweb primary-road centerlines for the Echols-Valdosta demo envelope
sources.transformations: scripts/build_echols_valdosta_demand_proxies.mjs deterministically samples 18 points from these centerlines inside the scenario envelope and applies a documented synthetic 12-54 meter offset.
sources.limitations: A road centerline establishes only public map geometry. It does not establish traffic volume, crash frequency, EMS demand, access, road conditions, or the location of a real incident.

sources.title: TIGERweb secondary-road centerlines for the Echols-Valdosta demo envelope
sources.transformations: scripts/build_echols_valdosta_demand_proxies.mjs deterministically samples 12 points from these centerlines inside the scenario envelope and applies a documented synthetic 12-54 meter offset.
sources.limitations: A road centerline establishes only public map geometry. It does not establish traffic volume, crash frequency, EMS demand, access, road conditions, or the location of a real incident.
